item.title: West Baton Rouge Fire crew extinguishes electrical fire
item.description: ERWINVILLE - A West Baton Rouge Fire crew extinguished an electrical fire at an Erwinville gas station Thursday evening.&nbsp;WBR Fire said Juneau's Cajun Meats was closed when the fire was reported.&nbsp;Firefighters found smoke in the building and determined it was an electrical fire, which was quickly extinguished.&nbsp;Permalink| Comments
